resources.string: Bluetooth resume
Prompts to resume playback when a background start is blocked or the Bluetooth device can\u0027t be verified
Resume playback
Tap to continue your last queue
No saved queue — open the app to play
No downloaded tracks available offline — open the app
Bluetooth connected — tap to resume (device identity unavailable)
Resume
Bluetooth
Bluetooth auto play
When a Bluetooth audio device connects, start the last queue automatically.

Enable Bluetooth auto play so the car sees FTP Music and playback starts on connect. Unrestricted battery and notifications help after deep sleep. If the OS blocks background start, press Play on the wheel.
After long sleep, set battery usage to Unrestricted so Bluetooth auto play can start in the background.
Ignore remote stop
Treat Stop from the car or headset as Pause so the queue is kept for reconnect. Recommended for cars that clear media on disconnect.
Unrestricted battery
Battery unrestricted — background resume after sleep is allowed
Open system Settings and set battery usage to Unrestricted for reliable Bluetooth resume after deep sleep
Notifications are off — if Android blocks background start, no Resume prompt can appear and the car may show no media provider. Enable notifications for reliable deep-sleep reconnect.
Notifications denied — enable them in Settings for resume prompts
Any audio device
Headphones, speakers, car — any A2DP sink
Selected devices
Only the paired devices you choose below
Devices
No paired Bluetooth devices. Pair a device in system Settings first.
Bluetooth permission required to list paired devices
Open Default apps settings
Android has no music default-app role. Soft routing prefers the last media app you played — play FTP Music once before driving.
Open system Default apps if your OEM lists a media preference.
FTP Music is preferred for system media when it was last playing
